description: Hand-read verdicts on corpus findings no label confirms: every finding that landed on a labelled line under a class the label does not expect, plus a seeded random sample of 40 of the 1687 findings no label covers. A finding is true when it names a defect a reviewer would act on in a security review of that line; a speculative runtime failure in code that cannot reach the claimed state is false.

new_rule_pass_2026_09_24.description: Hand verdicts on the rules added by the XSS and path-traversal recall change. Every finding of each new rule was read where the rule produced ten or fewer; where it produced more, a sample was read and the count is named in the rule's own evidence line.

secrets_pass_2026_09_27.description: Hand verdicts on both signals of the secrets detector, over the eleven clean repositories, the 23 corpus trees and this repository's own tracked files. Every finding of both signals was read, so the seeded-sample rule was not needed: the signals produced 42 findings between them, 20 under `secret.format.known_key` and 22 under `secret.entropy.credential_assignment`. A finding is true when the value on the line is credential material a reviewer would act on in a security review of that line, and false when it is a published example or a local fixture that grants nothing. Three of the false positives were detector defects and are fixed in the same change; they keep their verdicts here and carry `no_longer_fires`.

workflow_tampering_pass_2026_09_27.description: Hand verdicts on the nine GitHub Actions workflow rules, measured over the `.github/workflows` directory of 27 repositories at pinned refs: the eleven clean replay repositories, the fifteen vulnerable-corpus repositories that have one, and this repository. 240 workflow files. Every finding was read where a rule produced ten or fewer; where it produced more, a seeded random ten was read and the seed is recorded here. Two of the verdict sets are on the pattern a rule was narrowed away from rather than on what it produces now, which is deliberate: the reading is what caused the narrowing, and the same lines are checked in as no-finding cases in benchmarks/tier2-precision/cases.json.
